column6: The back-translation alters the terminology used to describe the attributes, changing 'foundational' to 'essential' and 'ability' to 'capability-related,' which may affect the theological understanding of God's nature and attributes.
column7: The attributes are grouped into relational, moral, foundational, ability categories. Relational attributes describe how we personally experience God. Moral attributes describe His character. Foundational attributes describe His essential nature of being.
column8: Attributes are divided into relational, moral, essential, and capability-related groups. Relational attributes describe how we personally encounter God. Moral attributes describe His character. Essential attributes describe His basic nature of being.
